detaileddescription.para: Returns the CSMP finite element type enum identifier that corresponds to the ANSYS type as identified by an integer identifier. The user needs to specify whether an isoparametric or globally interpolated element shall be returned because ANSYS elements can be converted into both.
Note however that ANSYS fits quadratic or cubic elements to the bounding curves. Thus, global interpolation will give incorrect results as it works only for straight-sided elements.

briefdescription.para: Represents ANSYS element type specifications that are needed prior to model construction in order to identify corresponding element types in CSMP++.

sect1.title: Motivation
sect1.para: Relates the ANSYS finite element types to the generic finite element names that are used inside of CSP. Also additional diagnostics are obtained as to whether the element is a line, surface, or volume, and whether the element uses linear, quadratic or cubic basis functions. Furthermore the element can be queried for the number of neighbors and its minimum spatial dimension.
